title: Bottom Aeration System
description: Our patented sediment aeration device diffuses air at the sediment level where the majority of waste and aquatic species shelter and helps maintain dissolved oxygen at the sediment-oxygen boundary layer.

title: Power Monitoring
description: Studying power measurements allows teams to observe equipment performance, discover electrical problems, assess how an asset is consuming power, and even if assets are on or off.
features: Automated health monitoring of paddle wheel aerator
Remote operation of starter for paddle wheel operation
Automated changeover to diesel in power failure situation
Alerts via call or message for paddle wheel or power failure

title: Monitoring System (Water Sampling and Sensing Unit)
description: Our cost-effective AI-IoT based robotic sampling-cum-sensing device provides targeted (depth, location & quantity) water quality data as per the customer's need.
features: Remote operation via cell phone dashboard
Predicts DO, pH, Nitrite, Phosphate, Vibrio

title: IoT Gateway
description: A single LoRaWAN gateway can receive data from 100s of water quality sensors, with a range of over 10 km line-of-sight through a long-range RF link.
features: Connected to internet via WiFi, Ethernet, or 4G

title: Automated Feeder
description: The feed distribution mechanism is the main component in an automatic feeder and distinguishes it from a feed dispenser. Feeders can be rack-mounted or buoy-based.
features: Variable dispersion and projectile of feed
Integration with water quality, energy monitoring & feed tray
Daily feed reports via web app

title: Feed Tray
description: The main objective of feed monitoring is to align the daily feed ratio closely with actual requirements. Our tray enables better observation and feed adjustments.
